releaseNotes:
Hubble 1.4.1

Hubble 1.4.1: Evertz routing and Stream Deck beta

- Add Evertz Quartz routing for direct routers and MAGNUM, with live feedback, source and destination names, destination locks, and system salvos.
- Add direct Stream Deck control (Beta), including device setup, page editing, button assignments, and saved workspace transfers.
- Open Button Layout on Companion by default at startup and keep your chosen integration during the current session.
- Label the direct integration Stream Deck (Beta).
